TOOLING BURST FL-4b — fire lane round 4b: bind the round-2 paintings — interleaving flames (random per hit) from peak-02, white-hot head, flame-sheet wake (Run C-5, FIRE LANE; Matt R-C5-109; conductor R-C5-113). task_id "FL-4b". Runs AFTER FL-4a (tempo, living-ember ending, projectile layers) — build on FL-4a's runtime, do not re-open it.

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4e (spatial shards), T4h (burst_v2), T4p (E1 arms), T4q, FL-4a and the new row "FL-4b — bind the round-2 fire paintings" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. oracle/peak_pieces.py (run only — the shard decomposition), export/effect_kit.py (pieces validation, travel_primitives, key_states), export/godot_import.py (burst_v2 pieces phase after FL-4a; the painted projectile: head/streak binding, rear socket, FL-4a core/trail/sheet hooks), the paintings (512 working copies, four-plane greyscale RGBA): runs/C-5/artifacts/E0p-peak-02/fire_peak_02_512.png (the SYMMETRICAL peak, 364×311 px), runs/C-5/artifacts/VF-prim-fire-head-02/fire_head_02_512.png (white-hot head, 160×104), runs/C-5/artifacts/VF-prim-fire-sheet-01/fire_sheet_01_512.png (flame-sheet wake, 296×110); the current kits runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/, fire_bolt_e1_A/, fire_bolt_e1_B/ (+ kit.json), runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json, tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART A — INTERLEAVING FLAMES, RANDOM PER HIT (Matt R-C5-113: "don't make the peak exactly symmetrical — use what we have and add interleaving flames between the long arms so the disparity isn't as great; encode a relatively random pattern so the interleaving flames change on each hit"). The burst body stays the APPROVED peak-01 (fire_burst_e0p_v2's pieces: the 11 shards + white core). NEW: an INTERLEAVE LIBRARY cut from fire_peak_02_512.png — run oracle/peak_pieces.py on it and take its ten short scalloped tongues as individual tongue pieces (each with pivot at its root and its radial angle); store them as `pieces/interleave/tongue_NN.png` in a NEW kit `fire_burst_e0p_v3` (copy of _v2 + `interleave` block). At CONTACT the runtime SEEDS from the cast (effect_id ⊕ contact frame ⊕ a world random) and selects 3–5 tongues from the library (`interleave {{count [3,5], library "pieces/interleave", angle_slots "gaps"}}`): it computes the angular GAPS between peak-01's shard radial angles (the largest gaps first), places one tongue per gap at the gap's bisector, rooted at the core's rim (distance = the core piece radius × 0.9), rotated to the bisector ± 12° jitter, scaled 0.8–1.15 with seeded jitter, mirrored 50/50; the tongues fly with the burst_v2 rule at 0.85× the shard speed (they are shorter), erode outside-in with everything else, and share the additive core/boil/afterglow. Every cast uses a different seed → a different set/placement (assert: two casts with different seeds differ in tongue ids or angles; the same seed reproduces). NO painted key states on _v3 (key_states []) — the holds retire; the core piece holds 2 f while shards + tongues fly. Ground squash 0.6 as _v2. Register _v3 (18th kit); fire_bolt_e1_B's impact_binding → _v3; _v2 stays (comparison). Validate; trace clause: for 5 seeds, tongue count in [3,5], placed in the 3–5 largest gaps, max angular gap after placement ≤ 55° (was ≈ 90–110° between the octopus arms), selection differs across seeds; peak extent ≈ 4.0 BH at the expanded moment.

PART B — THE PROJECTILE PAINTINGS. fire_bolt_e1_B (and _A) travel_primitives: head → fire_head_02 (pivot at the blunt leading end's centre, rear_socket at the tail hook root, scale for 1.2 BH across), streak → fire_sheet_01 as the wake (scale for 2.2 BH long, anchored at the head's rear socket, tail to the left along −direction); the FL-4a additive white-hot core uses the head's band-3 plane (now ~40 % of the body — verify the core reads as the leading half); the boil/erode drift applies to the sheet; the ember trail sheds from the sheet's tail wisps. Trace clause: head drawn extent 1.15–1.25 BH, sheet 2.1–2.3 BH, sheet attached at the rear socket at every frame; ice byte-identical.
PART C — byte locks re-opened: re-baseline only with per-lock diff summaries (FL-1b rule); the catalogue lock stays red (E3-r1) — name it (it will need the 18th kit next time it is re-baselined).

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/FL-4b/acceptance.json): pieces record; the trace clauses; 15 kits byte-identical (the two fire arms: kit.json + primitives copied from the working copies; _v3 new); full 18-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 (gl_compatibility); in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): interleave seeding/placement clauses (gap coverage ≤ 55°, differs across seeds, reproducible per seed); the projectile extents; 18-kit registry; extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (run only), export/replay.py, any kit except the two fire arms and the new fire_burst_e0p_v3, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/FL-4b/, the new kit directory and its registration line; fixtures/ only for Part C. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/FL-4b/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "FL-4b"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
